remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600 -DWINVER=0x600)

spec2def(normaliz.dll normaliz.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# normaliz.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/normaliz-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(normaliz_shims OBJECT IdnToAscii.c IdnToUnicode.c nameprep.c normalize.c)
target_link_libraries(normaliz_shims PRIVATE libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_cargo_module(normaliz normaliz-cargo normaliz.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS normaliz_shims)
